evidence.explanation: JS lcase replaces C strcmpi for recognized ASCII flag names; the extra helper is equivalent case normalization in this tested domain.
evidence.proof: Exact C lspo_level_flags, strncmpi and lowc bodies with fixed string-stack adapters match public JS des.level_flags in 54 comparisons: 18 names, three ASCII case spellings. Level-flag storage only; no Unicode, embedded NUL, coder-private flags, errors or finalization claims.
